snippet.title: The Landlord's Legacy | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A cozy management sim where your tenants are the mystery.

Restore a derelict East Village building flat by flat: scrub, paint and repair, choose who moves in, win their trust and track the rumours that circulate. Most odd goings-on have a normal explanation. Not all. You have one year to save it from the property developer.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5385540/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=page_launch&utm_content=trailer
Discord: https://discord.gg/PZdATy2D5j

Early Access in 2027. Made by a solo developer.
Music: COZY: ReSound.
